result.stdout:
Configurable developer workflow orchestrator. All subcommand behavior is driven by CalqFramework.Config preset POCOs.

Submodules
  config                c  Configuration management (path, push, pull).

Subcommands
  complete-project-type    
  complete-issues          
  new                   n  Bootstraps a new repository from organization templates.
  format                f  Runs the configurable format pipeline on a directory.
  pull                     Pulls from remote with rebase, regardless of current branch.
  switch                s  Switches to or creates an issue branch.
  push                     Pushes to remote. Behavior differs on main vs feature branches.
  merge                 m  Squash-merges the current feature branch PR and cleans up.
  relock                r  Forces re-evaluation of the dependency graph and updates lock files.
  issues                i  Lists open issues from GitHub.
